events.verdict: Gobert (UTA) makes incidental contact with Embiid (PHI) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Rubio (UTA) cleanly steals the ball from Redick (PHI).
Simmons (PHI) legally contests Rubio's (UTA) driving shot attempt.
Crowder (UTA) makes contact with Redick (PHI) that does not affect his FOM.
RLS shows Rubio (UTA) makes contact with Redick (PHI) that affects his ability to get to the pass.
Gobert (UTA) is established in a screening position in Butler's (PHI) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver the contact.
Mitchell (UTA) makes incidental contact with Chandler (PHI) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Redick (PHI) briefly places his arms at Rubio's (UTA) sides when they engage, but he does not push him into Crowder (UTA).
Mitchell (UTA) makes contact with Simmons' (PHI) arm and body that affects his driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] PXP shows Gobert (UTA) and Embiid (PHI) step into the lane prior to the release of the free throw.
Chandler (PHI) and Crowder (UTA) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
The ball does not land out of bounds prior to Mitchell (UTA) gaining possession of the rebound.
Rubio (UTA) and Redick (PHI) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Crowder (UTA) briefly places his hand on Redick's (PHI) hip but he immediately removes it without affecting Redick's SQBR.
RLS shows Crowder (UTA) makes marginal contact with Embiid (PHI) that does not affect his ability to control the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Embiid (PHI) slides his pivot foot before passing.
Gobert (UTA) has his arms extended on the screen, but the contact with Butler (PHI) is marginal.
Gobert (UTA) is not established in a screening position in Butler's (PHI) path and he delivers the contact.
Rubio (UTA) commits a take foul on Embiid (PHI).
Butler (PHI) legally contests Mitchell's (UTA) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Simmons (PHI) makes incidental contact with Ingles (UTA) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
